invariants.rationale: inputRecords is likely intended to be a valid list of records for writing; null input may not be permitted.
A non-null execution context is typically required to perform the write operation.
A valid table reference is necessary to apply the write operation.
Method calls on config are made immediately in the body, so config must not be null.
An operation type is required to define the semantics of the write; null would likely cause errors or unpredictable behavior.
